canonical_data: Generated Next.js project files in a local Git working tree, plus a local SQLite/Prisma database of projects, chat sessions, and deployment state
current_repo_note: Originating organisation opactorai renamed to anymorph-ai; the last commit is dated 2026-03-04 and feature PRs and issues opened through 2026-07-28 remain unaddressed as of this review.
strengths: Five vendor coding-agent CLI/SDK integrations behind one build-and-deploy workflow
End-to-end path from prompt to live preview to Vercel deployment to a provisioned Supabase database
Packaged Electron desktop build alongside the local dev-server workflow
weaknesses: No commits since March 2026, with feature PRs and issues opened as late as July 2026 still unaddressed
Runs agents with full host access by design; the README advertises 'no complex sandboxes'
Originating organisation renamed and shows no visible new activity on this repository since
why_it_matters: Shows how far a thin, now-dormant wrapper over five vendors' coding-agent CLIs can still take a single prompt to a deployed, database-backed web app.
